title: 建築設備総論
subtitle: Introduction of Building Equipment
keywords: Air conditioner and ventilation design 2.Water supply and drainage sanitary installation 3.Building equipment 4.Data Science 5.Area cooperation
educationalGoal: It's learned about important air conditioning and building equipment in general of ventilating installation and water supply and drainage sanitary installation by building equipment and the ability which can be applied to an equipment design is learned through a problem and a practice. Air current analysis technology is learned by a practice as air streaming design technique based on data science for aerial environmental improvement.
advice: Building equipment in general is explained by the lecture focusing on air conditioning among the building equipment, ventilating installation and water supply and drainage sanitary installation and basic terminology and concept of building equipment in general are understood by a practice. A practice of a way of thinking with a basic equipment design is performed based on those. The damage case and the trial case which have formed by building equipment in general are considered by a lecture and a practice. An analysis of strong winds blowing through the tall buildings by air current analysis technology base on data science is performed and a basic skill of analysis technology is learned to know more construction and aerial relation. Architecture and building equipment. Knowledge of an air conditioner and design concept. Knowledge and design concept of water supply and drainage sanitary installation. Site electrical facilities and firefighting equipment. Disaster preventing. Way of thinking of ventilation design and ventilation design. Damage example of the building equipment field, precedent and consideration. Acquisition of air current analysis technology and analysis of strong winds blowing through the tall buildings.
books: Building Environmental Engineering Teaching Materials -Equipment-,MARUZEN,2011 ISBN978-4-8189-2224-2
requiredKnowledge: Understand the technological figure and way of thinking which come out by a textbook and distributed material in order to understand a concept of the language used by building equipment in general. It's free-hand, to be able to draw an image figure of the degree others can understand more.

achievementLevels.ideal: It can be explained about comfortable environmental in building and a realization method to the city environment healthily based on knowledge of building equipment in general.A student can understand a way of thinking of an air conditioner and water supply and drainage sanitary installation, design easily and explain about that.Easy ventilation design can understand a way of thinking of ventilation and explain about that, and is done. It's possible to put on legal knowledge based on a trial case in the construction field as well as consider a corrective action from a social technical viewpoint. A practicing analysis of strong winds blowing through the tall buildings is made of air current analysis technology.
achievementLevels.standard: The basic language of building equipment in general can be explained. A way of thinking of an air conditioner and water supply and drainage sanitary installation can be understood and explained. A student can understand air environment and a way of thinking of ventilation design and explain about that. A student puts on knowledge legal than a trial case in the construction field. The wind analysis in a building with the easy shape can be made air current analysis technology.

lessons.content: Learning support plan and overview of the entire course. Architecture and building equipment. 1.Temperature and CO2 emissions 2.Carbon neutral 3.Architecture and climate 4.Japan's climate and design weather conditions 5.Japan's energy situation 6.Urbanization and building equipment 7.History of equipment 8.Energy-saving design 9.Equipment design overview
lessons.operation: Lecture and question and answer. A practice problem is solved.

lessons.content: Air conditioning equipment. 1.How air and heat work in homes 2.How air conditioning equipment works 3.Hot heat source: boiler 4.Cold heat source: refrigeration unit 5.Heat pumps and COP 6.Cooling towers

Heat storage tanks and space for equipment. 1.Heat storage tanks 2.Heat storage methods and power load leveling 3.Water heat storage and ice heat storage 4.Cogeneration systems 5.Air conditioning equipment configuration 6.Building equipment design 7.Required space design for equipment machine ro oms, etc. 8.Classification of air outlets and allowable te mperature difference of air outlet

Water supply and drainage sanitary equipment. 1.Water supply and drainage/sanitary equipment 2.Piping 3.Water supply equipment, water supply pipes, wa ter supply load 4.Reverse siphoning 5.Vacuum breaker 6.Water hammer 7.Trap Review of the lesson.
lessons.operation: Lecture and question and answer. Tuition's looking and self-check.

lessons.content: What is CFD? The outline of CFD (Computational fluid dynamics). The explanation of CFD software.
Elementary knowledge for CFD. Installation of CFD software (STREAM).
lessons.operation: Lecture and question and answer. Installation support.

lessons.content: Blower, electrical equipment, fire extinguishing equipment. 1. Blower 2. Parallel and serial operation of blowers 3. Voltage classification 4. Grounding 5. Electrical equipment 6. Fire extinguishing equipment 7. Smoke exhaust equipment 8. Gas leak detector 9. Noise and vibration prevention measures from air conditioning equipment Looking back on the lesson.
lessons.operation: A practice problem is solved. Tuition's looking and self-check.

lessons.content: About wind and building wind. The explanation of an analysis of strong winds blowing through the tall buildings by CFD.

Air environment and air quality. 1.Air environment 2.Composition of atmospheric air 3.Air quality standards 4.Indoor air quality 5.CO2 concentration as an indicator of air pollu tion 6.Health damage caused by indoor air quality 7.Sick building syndrome 8.Indoor chemical pollutants 9.Formaldehyde and other sick house countermeasu res 10.Residential sick house countermeasures 11.Formula for calculating indoor pollutant conc entration (Seidel formula) 12.Example 1, 2 of calculating required ventilat ion volume using Seidel formula Air quality-related damage and case studies.
Experience of an analysis of strong winds blowing through the tall buildings. An analysis of strong winds blowing through the tall buildings using CFD is experienced.
lessons.operation: Lecture and question and answer. Analysis exercises using STREAM

lessons.content: Ventilation design by the wind velocity. Way of thinking of ventilation design and way by the wind velocity.
Ventilation design by the temperature difference. Way of thinking and way of the ventilation design for which the temperature difference was used. Looking of ventilation design.
lessons.operation: Lecture and question and answer. Tuition's looking and self-check.

lessons.content: Reproducing wind phenomena around buildings and verifying the effectiveness of countermeasures. Explanation of a reproduction example using CFD. Case study of wind-around-building law suits Rev iew of exercises from lessons 1 to 12.
Exam based on the contents of lessons 1 to 13. Presentation of selected analysis tasks (selecte d from exercise tasks targeting wind over buildi ngs).

Supplementary information on ventilation and air quality. 1.Ventilation methods 2.Microorganisms: tuberculosis 3.Legionnaires' disease 4.Mesothelioma caused by asbestos 5.Suspended dust 6.Oxygen 7.Nitrogen 8.Body odor 9.Odor 10.Corrosion accidents such as salt damage 11.Ventilation measures to improve air quality Case studies in the field of architecture. Reflection on the entire course. Grade evaluation.
lessons.operation: Lecture and practice All tuition's looking. And self-check
